title.en: Chi-square test for variance and F-test

hook.en: A cement plant must keep the strength of its bricks steady, not just right on average. Tests on *variance* answer questions like "Is the variability more than allowed?" and "Is machine A as consistent as machine B?"
hook.kn: ಸಿಮೆಂಟ್ ಘಟಕ ಇಟ್ಟಿಗೆಗಳ ಬಲವನ್ನು ಸರಾಸರಿಯಲ್ಲಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿಯೂ ಇಡಬೇಕು. "ಚಂಚಲತೆ ಅನುಮತಿಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚೇ?", "ಯಂತ್ರ A ಯಂತ್ರ B ಯಷ್ಟೇ ಸ್ಥಿರವೇ?" ಎಂಬ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಸರಣ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

title.en: Test a population variance with chi-square
Test the equality of two variances with F

say.en: A cement plant must keep the strength of its bricks steady, not just right on average. Tests on variance answer questions like "Is the variability more than allowed?" and "Is machine A as consistent as machine B?" In this lesson: Test a population variance with chi-square.
Test the equality of two variances with F.
Read χ squared and F tables.

body.en: To test $H_0: \sigma^2 = \sigma_0^2$ from a sample of size $n$ from a normal population: $\chi^2 = \dfrac{\sum (x - \bar{x})^2}{\sigma_0^2} = \dfrac{(n-1)s^2}{\sigma_0^2}$ with $n - 1$ d.f. For $H_1: \sigma^2 > \sigma_0^2$, reject $H_0$ if $\chi^2$ exceeds the upper table value $\chi^2_{\alpha}(n-1)$.
body.kn: H₀: σ² = σ₀² ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು χ² = Σ(x − x̄)²/σ₀² = (n − 1)s²/σ₀², d.f. n − 1. H₁: σ² > σ₀² ಆದರೆ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬೆಲೆ ಮೀರಿದಾಗ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ.

narration.en: To test H_0: sigma^2 = sigma_0^2 from a sample of size n from a normal population: chi-square = dfracsum (x - x-bar)^2sigma_0^2 = dfrac(n-1)s^2sigma_0^2 with n - 1 d.f. For H_1: sigma^2 > sigma_0^2, reject H_0 if chi-square exceeds the upper table value chi-square_alpha(n-1).
narration.kn: H₀: σ² = σ₀² ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು χ² = Σ(x − x̄)²/σ₀² = (n − 1)s²/σ₀², d.f. n − 1. H₁: σ² > σ₀² ಆದರೆ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬೆಲೆ ಮೀರಿದಾಗ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ.

say.en: To test H 0: sigma^2 equals sigma 0 to the power 2 from a sample of size n from a normal population: chi-square equals dfracsum (x - x-bar)^2sigma 0 to the power 2 equals dfrac(n-1)s^2sigma 0 to the power 2 with n minus 1 d.f. For H 1: sigma^2 is greater than sigma 0 to the power 2, reject H 0 if chi-square exceeds the upper table value chi-square alpha(n-1). χ squared equals Σ(x - x̄) squared/ sigma 0 squared.
say.kn: H 0: sigma squared equals sigma 0 squared ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು χ squared equals Σ(x - x̄) squared/ sigma 0 squared equals n minus 1s squared/ sigma 0 squared, d.f. n minus 1. H 1: sigma squared > sigma 0 squared ಆದರೆ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬೆಲೆ ಮೀರಿದಾಗ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ.

say.en: d.f. = n minus 1.
Normal population assumed.

title.en: Variance tests worked on the board

narration.en: The teacher works one chi-square test for a variance and one F-test, marking the critical value each time.

say.en: A sample of 10 bricks gives a sum of squared deviations of 180. Test whether sigma squared is 9 against more than 9.
Draw chi-square with 9 d.f. The 5 percent point is 16.92. Our 20 is beyond it.
So we reject H nought: the variability is more than allowed.
Now the F-test. Two machines: 11 and 9 packets, with variances 25 and 10. F is 25 over 10, which is 2.5.
The 5 percent value of F for 10 and 8 d.f. is 3.35. 2.5 is smaller, so the machines are equally consistent.
The teacher works one chi-square test for a variance and one F-test, marking the critical value each time.

narration.en: Two samples of the same size n from normal populations. Set their unbiased variances s₁² and s₂². F is the larger over the smaller, with (n − 1, n − 1) d.f. If it lands beyond the 5% table value (red region), H₀: σ₁² = σ₂² is rejected.

caption.en: Two samples of the same size n from normal populations. Set their unbiased variances s₁² and s₂². F is the larger over the smaller, with (n − 1, n − 1) d.f. If it lands beyond the 5% table value (red region), H₀: σ₁² = σ₂² is rejected.
caption.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಸಮಷ್ಟಿಗಳಿಂದ ಒಂದೇ ಗಾತ್ರ n ನ ಎರಡು ಮಾದರಿಗಳು. ಅವುಗಳ ಪಕ್ಷಪಾತರಹಿತ ಚದುರಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಿ. F = ದೊಡ್ಡದು ÷ ಚಿಕ್ಕದು, (n − 1, n − 1) ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಮಟ್ಟ. 5% ಕೋಷ್ಟಕ ಬೆಲೆ ಆಚೆ ಬಿದ್ದರೆ H₀ ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

tryThis.en: With n = 9, how big must the ratio of variances be to be significant?
Keep s₁² = 2 s₂² and increase n. When does the difference become significant?
Why do we always put the larger variance in the numerator?

say.en: Two samples of the same size n from normal populations. Set their unbiased variances s 1 squared and s 2 squared. F is the larger over the smaller, with (n minus 1, n minus 1) d.f. If it lands beyond the 5 percent table value red region, H 0: sigma 1 squared equals sigma 2 squared is rejected.

body.en: To test $H_0: \sigma_1^2 = \sigma_2^2$ from two independent samples from normal populations: $F = \dfrac{s_1^2}{s_2^2}$ with $(n_1 - 1, n_2 - 1)$ d.f., where $s_1^2 = \dfrac{\sum(x - \bar{x})^2}{n_1 - 1}$, $s_2^2 = \dfrac{\sum(y - \bar{y})^2}{n_2 - 1}$ and the larger estimate is put in the numerator. Reject $H_0$ if $F > F_{\alpha}(n_1 - 1, n_2 - 1)$.
body.kn: H₀: σ₁² = σ₂² ಗೆ F = s₁²/s₂², d.f. (n₁ − 1, n₂ − 1); ದೊಡ್ಡ ಅಂದಾಜು ಅಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ. ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದ ಬೆಲೆ ಮೀರಿದರೆ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ.

points.en: d.f. (n₁ − 1, n₂ − 1) in the same order

narration.en: To test H_0: sigma_1^2 = sigma_2^2 from two independent samples from normal populations: F = dfracs_1^2s_2^2 with (n_1 - 1, n_2 - 1) d.f., where s_1^2 = dfracsum(x - x-bar)^2n_1 - 1, s_2^2 = dfracsum(y - y)^2n_2 - 1 and the larger estimate is put in the numerator. Reject H_0 if F > F_alpha(n_1 - 1, n_2 - 1).
narration.kn: H₀: σ₁² = σ₂² ಗೆ F = s₁²/s₂², d.f. (n₁ − 1, n₂ − 1); ದೊಡ್ಡ ಅಂದಾಜು ಅಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ. ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದ ಬೆಲೆ ಮೀರಿದರೆ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ.

say.en: To test H 0: sigma 1 to the power 2 equals sigma 2 to the power 2 from two independent samples from normal populations: F equals dfracs 1 to the power 2s 2 to the power 2 with (n 1 minus 1, n 2 minus 1) d.f., where s 1 to the power 2 equals dfracsum(x - x-bar)^2n 1 minus 1, s 2 to the power 2 equals dfracsum(y - y)^2n 2 minus 1 and the larger estimate is put in the numerator. Reject H 0 if F is greater than F alpha(n 1 minus 1, n 2 minus 1). Unbiased s squared divisor n minus 1.
say.kn: H 0: sigma 1 squared equals sigma 2 squared ಗೆ F equals s 1 squared/s 2 squared, d.f. (n 1 minus 1, n 2 minus 1); ದೊಡ್ಡ ಅಂದಾಜು ಅಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ. ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದ ಬೆಲೆ ಮೀರಿದರೆ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ.

say.en: Larger variance on top.
d.f. (n 1 minus 1, n 2 minus 1) in the same order.

problem.en: Two machines fill packets. Sample 1: 9 packets, Σ(x − x̄)² = 184. Sample 2: 11 packets, Σ(y − ȳ)² = 200. Test at 5% whether the variances are equal. (F₀.₀₅(8, 10) = 3.07)

steps.en: The two machines are equally consistent.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Two machines fill packets. Sample 1: 9 packets, Σ(x − x̄)² = 184. Sample 2: 11 packets, Σ(y − ȳ)² = 200. Test at 5% whether the variances are equal. (F₀.₀₅(8, 10) = 3.07)

say.en: Let us work this out together. Two machines fill packets. Sample 1: 9 packets, Σ(x - x̄) squared equals 184. Sample 2: 11 packets, Σ(y - ȳ) squared equals 200. Test at 5 percent whether the variances are equal. (F 0. 05(8, 10) equals 3.07).
s 1 squared equals 184 over 8 equals 23; s 2 squared equals 200 over 10 equals 20.
F equals 23 over 20 equals 1.15 with (8, 10) d.f.
1.15 is less than 3.07: H 0 is not rejected.
The two machines are equally consistent.
So the answer is F equals 1.15; variances may be equal.

body.en: For χ² use the raw sum of squares Σ(x − x̄)² over σ₀². For F, first divide each sum of squares by its own n − 1, then take larger ÷ smaller.

say.en: Divisor check. For χ squared use the raw sum of squares Σ(x - x̄) squared over sigma 0 squared. For F, first divide each sum of squares by its own n minus 1, then take larger divided by smaller.

title.en: Chi-square tests: goodness of fit and independence of attributes

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Variance test: χ squared equals Σ(x - x̄) squared/ sigma 0 squared, n minus 1 d.f.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಪ್ರಸರಣ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ: χ squared equals Σ(x - x̄) squared/ sigma 0 squared, d.f. n minus 1.

say.en: F equals s 1 squared/s 2 squared larger on top, (n 1 minus 1, n 2 minus 1) d.f.
say.kn: F equals s 1 squared/s 2 squared (ದೊಡ್ಡದು ಮೇಲೆ), d.f. (n 1 minus 1, n 2 minus 1).

say.en: Use the unbiased variance s squared with divisor n minus 1.
say.kn: ಅಪಕ್ಷಪಾತಿ s squared (ಛೇದ n minus 1) ಬಳಸಿ.

say.en: Both tests assume normal populations.
